title: "02 - Clean Data"
format: html

---

## Library Loading

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
```

## Load Data

```{r}
#| message: false

# gives Delimiter: "\t" message, mb worth resolving
mortality_raw <- read_tsv(file = here("data/_raw/01_mortality_load.tsv"))
measles_raw <- read_tsv(file = here("data/_raw/01_measles_load.tsv"))
stunting_raw  <- read_tsv(file = here("data/_raw/01_stunting_load.tsv"))
```

## Clean Mortality Data

```{r}
mortality_clean <- mortality_raw |>
  filter(Dim1 == "Both sexes") |> 
  mutate(
    mortality_rate = as.numeric(str_extract(Value, "^[0-9.]+"))
  ) |>
  select(
    country_code = SpatialDimValueCode,
    country = Location,
    region = ParentLocation,
    year = Period,
    mortality_rate
  )
```

## Clean Measles Data

```{r}
measles_clean <- measles_raw |>
  mutate(
    measles_coverage = as.numeric(str_extract(Value, "^[0-9.]+"))
  ) |>
  select(
    country_code = SpatialDimValueCode,
    country = Location,
    region = ParentLocation,
    year = Period,
    measles_coverage
  )
```

## Clean Stunting Data

```{r}
stunting_clean <- stunting_raw |>
  mutate(
    stunting_prevalence = as.numeric(str_extract(Value, "^[0-9.]+"))
  ) |>
  select(
    country_code = SpatialDimValueCode,
    country = Location,
    region = ParentLocation,
    year = Period,
    stunting_prevalence,
    FactComments
  )
```

## Store Cleaned Data

```{r}
write_tsv(mortality_clean, file = here("data/02_mortality_clean.tsv"))
write_tsv(measles_clean, file = here("data/02_measles_clean.tsv"))
write_tsv(stunting_clean, file = here("data/02_stunting_clean.tsv"))
```
